# Protobuf and telemetry metadata privileges require audited module sources.
# SDK development checkouts are supported. No fixture downloads a module.
[short] skip

# SDK sources may come from an explicit development checkout.
go build -mod=mod -o sdkfixture ./hostsdk

# A nested module cannot inherit the parent SDK's metadata namespace.
cp go.mod baseline.go.mod
cp sdk-nested.go.mod go.mod
! go build -mod=mod -o sdkfixture ./hostsdk
stderr 'SDK metadata services require go.temporal.io/sdk as the owning module'
cp baseline.go.mod go.mod

# OTel scalar ID sentinel reads require pinned, unreplaced trace API sources.
! go build -mod=mod ./hostotel
stderr 'metadata services require go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace@v1.44.0 without a replacement'

# Local replacements cannot impersonate an audited metadata implementation.
! go build -mod=mod ./host
stderr 'metadata services require google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.36.11 without a replacement, nested module, or vendored source'

# Host-only implementations may be reached through a shared registry callback.
! go build -mod=mod ./hostonly
stderr 'metadata services require google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.36.11 without a replacement, nested module, or vendored source'

# Vendor metadata cannot claim privileges by changing only modules.txt.
cp vendor.go.mod go.mod
! go build -mod=vendor ./host
stderr 'metadata services require google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.36.11 without a replacement, nested module, or vendored source'

# An unaudited version also fails before compilation.
cp old.go.mod go.mod
cp old.modules.txt vendor/modules.txt
! go build -mod=vendor ./host
stderr 'metadata services require google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.36.11'

# Nested modules cannot inherit the trusted namespace.
cp nested.go.mod go.mod
! go build -mod=mod ./host
stderr 'metadata services require google.golang.org/protobuf@v1.36.11'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolateMetadata

go 1.26

require google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.11
require go.temporal.io/sdk v1.49.0
require go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace v1.44.0
replace go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace => ./otelfake
replace google.golang.org/protobuf => ./fake
replace go.temporal.io/sdk => ./sdkfake
-- vendor.go.mod --
module example.org/isolateMetadata

go 1.26

require google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.11
-- sdk-nested.go.mod --
module example.org/isolateMetadata

go 1.26

require go.temporal.io/sdk/probe v0.0.0
replace go.temporal.io/sdk/probe => ./sdknested
-- sdknested/go.mod --
module go.temporal.io/sdk/probe
go 1.26
-- sdknested/probe.go --
package probe
func Value() int { return 1 }
-- old.go.mod --
module example.org/isolateMetadata

go 1.26

require google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.10
-- nested.go.mod --
module example.org/isolateMetadata

go 1.26

require google.golang.org/protobuf/probe v0.0.0
replace google.golang.org/protobuf/probe => ./nested
-- fake/go.mod --
module google.golang.org/protobuf

go 1.26
-- fake/probe/probe.go --
package probe
func Value() int { return 1 }
-- nested/go.mod --
module google.golang.org/protobuf/probe

go 1.26
-- nested/probe.go --
package probe
func Value() int { return 1 }
-- vendor/modules.txt --
# google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.11
## explicit; go 1.26
google.golang.org/protobuf/probe
-- old.modules.txt --
# google.golang.org/protobuf v1.36.10
## explicit; go 1.26
google.golang.org/protobuf/probe
-- vendor/google.golang.org/protobuf/probe/probe.go --
package probe
func Value() int { return 1 }
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs
import "google.golang.org/protobuf/probe"
//temporal:workflow
func Work() (int, error) { return probe.Value(), nil }
-- host/main.go --
package main
import "example.org/isolateMetadata/jobs"
func main() { jobs.Work() }

-- pure/jobs.go --
package pure
//temporal:workflow
func Work() (int, error) { return 1, nil }
-- hostonly/main.go --
package main
import (
 "example.org/isolateMetadata/pure"
 "google.golang.org/protobuf/probe"
)
func main() { pure.Work(); probe.Value() }
-- sdkfake/go.mod --
module go.temporal.io/sdk
go 1.26
-- sdkfake/probe/probe.go --
package probe
func Value() int { return 1 }
-- hostsdk/main.go --
package main
import (
 "example.org/isolateMetadata/pure"
 "go.temporal.io/sdk/probe"
)
func main() { pure.Work(); probe.Value() }

-- otelfake/go.mod --
module go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace

go 1.26
-- otelfake/trace.go --
package trace
func Value() int { return 1 }
-- hostotel/main.go --
package main
import (
 "example.org/isolateMetadata/pure"
 "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
)
func main() { pure.Work(); trace.Value() }
